notes.title: ⚙️ Dev Update – V1.3.19
notes.content:
Increased base walking speed by a little over 20%.
This change is meant as a compromise to make movement feel smoother, while still keeping the oppressive, nightmare-like atmosphere that defines the game.

Thank you for your feedback — keep it coming, it really helps shape the experience!

notes.title: ⚙️ Dev Update – V1.3.18
notes.content: The Use key now correctly follows your custom bindings. No more being stuck on "E".

notes.title: Dev Update – V1.3.17 👻
notes.content:
[p]Hey, Trapped,

⚙️ General optimization — smoother performance, improved stability.

⏱️ Chase timing adjusted — the pursuit starts earlier… before you even realize it.

🦶 Run + jump removed — in this nightmare, your movements are restricted. You’re no longer free to escape.

Every step is heavier. Every second is borrowed time.[/p]

notes.title: 🧠 Dev Update – V1.3.16 👻

🛠️ Adjusted button labels that were misaligned due to the last update and the font change.

notes.title: 🧠 Dev Update – V1.3.15 👻
notes.content:
Hey, Trapped,

🌍 7 new languages added + major improvements across all existing translations

👁️ Fixed the eye-blink screen effect on ultrawide displays — no more eyes drifting off into the void.

notes.title: 🧠 Dev Update – V1.3.5 👻
notes.content: 🎯 Ultra Wide Fix: The escape screen (ESC) now correctly displays the dark background on ultra-wide screens. No more broken visuals or weird edges — everything looks clean and immersive.

Fixed a camera bug that prevented progression in the Loop 4 DLC

Thank you so much for playing Psychomachia and its DLC, and for your feedback!
